selection.policy: retain check results and task bindings; omit unrelated copied runtime inventory

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The inferred edit is the added-cell set together with its input-derived edit-frame dimensions; for this qualified case delta={(1,4),(3,2)} in a 5x6 frame, whose 180-degree image is {(1,3),(3,1)}.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Align the nonzero bounding boxes of panels A and B, compute every bbox-relative cell present in B but absent from A, and retain the maximum A/B edit-frame height and width.
sequential_dependency.step_b: For the rotate_180 setting, rotate each inferred added-cell coordinate 180 degrees inside that exact edit frame, then stamp the transformed cells at panel C’s nonzero bounding-box origin using C’s color.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Panel C supplies only the destination origin and color. The cells to stamp and the frame needed to rotate them are recovered from the A-to-B edit, so replacing that intermediate with the unrotated delta changes the final grid.
